1477-2585-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-2585-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Grim Monolith, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

751-3499-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2464-3800-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3800-4687.description:
Activate Song of Freyalise by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

3602-4247--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-4247--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

640-728-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6159-7893.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6159-7893.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4136-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4136-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

475-1379-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-4186-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

792-1580-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4316-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1368-1563-6321-7060.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-7060.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2646-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
2646-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

856-2829-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

141-6556-7301.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
141-6556-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting Temur Battlecrier
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath targeting Temur Battlecrier
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.

323-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

874-1456-4195-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1456-4195-4574.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

729-2034-4613-4679--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
729-2034-4613-4679--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
729-2034-4613-4679--128.description:
Activate Great Oak Guardian using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Great Oak Guardian to Yenna and causing Great Oak Guardian to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Great Oak Guardian token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

261-2034-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
261-2034-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

3609-4222-6702.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
3609-4222-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well. The mana cost will be removed or replaced depending on what method you use to tap Kilo.

1445-2279-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-5686.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4826-4974-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4826-4974-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4826-4974-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2734-3941.description:
Animate Coveted Jewel using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.

5414-5478-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
5414-5478-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2837-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-2457-2837-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3368-4036-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Holding priority, activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Reiterate, copying Seething Song and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use the mana to cast Reiterate infinitely and copy any instant and/or sorcery spells on the stack.

1567-1760-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.
1567-1760-4364.description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Momentary Blink from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Momentary Blink without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Momentary Blink, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

3750-3975-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
3750-3975-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers twice, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 6 life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1817-1953-2743.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional token.
1817-1953-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Biovisionary spell.
Resolve both Biovisionaries.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Biovisionary token.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

2359-3197-4167.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2359-3197-4167.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Season of Growth's first ability triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Elrond's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

190-389-4233.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Nine Lives.
When Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Tranquil Domain by paying {1}{G}, destroying all non-Aura enchantments.
When aach opponent's Nine Lives leave the battlefield, they trigger, causing them to lose the game.

3249-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Su-Chi.
Cast Su-Chi from graveyard by paying {4}.
Repeat.

813-2665-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
813-2665-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the token Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons and up to one additional target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
